page.layout: Two woodcut medallion portraits centred at the top, with their legends printed around them (in notes). Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width, no marginal notes. Running head at the top right, page number at the top left.

main_text.l: CLODOVEVS hoc nomine primus, Francorum Rex
quintus, Francicæ vtique religionis conditor, succeffit patri
Childerico anno mundi 4448. à Christo nato 486. Hic vxorem
duxit Christianam Clotildem Burgundionem. Syagrius, Egidij
Romani filius (eius qui, expulso Childerico, Francis præfuerat)
à Sueffionibus expulsus, Tolosam confugit ad Alaricum Visi-
gothorum Regem: à quo proditus, & Clodoueo redditus, se-
curi percutitur. Sic defiere expulsi & cæsi in Galliis imperium
habere Romani. Deinde Clodoueus Turingiam debellat: à
Rheno ad Sequanam regnum ampliat: ad Ligerim vsque fines
suos extendit. In bello quod ad Tolbiacum geffit, periculi ma-
gnitudine, idolorúmque diffidentia, repente vouit se Christia-
num fore: voto facto Germanos hostes vicit, subegit, tributa
impofuit: à D. Remigio Remensi Episcopo cum Francis omni-
bus baptizatur. Post hæc Gundebaldum Burgúdiæ Regé regno
& patria cedere coëgit: Alaricum Regem cum suis Visigothis
fudit. Moenia Engolismæ ruinosa in cōspectu Clodouei vrbem
aggressuri ruunt: illinc Burdegalâ vsq; hostes insecutus, iterum
vicit. Omnes tum feré Gallias, & vniuersam Alemaniâ Rex sub
ditione tenuit: ab Anastasio Imper. dona recepit, Patritiatus &
Consulatus titulum, & insignia, coronâ insuper auream, multis
vnionibus distinctam, quam postea Româ D. Petro offerendam
remisit. rexit an. 30. Hic Lutetiæ sepultus est in æde quâ D. Petro
& Paulo erexerat: hodie Fanü D. Genouefes vocatur. Æmy. li. 1.
CHILDEBERTVS patri Clodoueo succeffit ann. mun-
di 4478. à Christo nato 516. Hic Almaricum fundit, occidit:
Hispanias populatur: sororē, quòd ab Arriana hærefi abhorre-
ret, à viro Almarico Alarici filio duiè tractatâ, reducit. Tādem
obiit sine liberis anno regni 45. Sepelitur in æde D. Germani
ad Parisios ab eo erecta, & dicata D. Vincentio.

page.notes: Medallion legends, printed inside the portraits and not in the text block: left medallion "F. REX" with "5" and "CLODOVEVS"; right medallion "FRAN. R. 6" and "CHILDEBERTVS". Doubtful readings: "defiere" (perhaps desierunt-type form) and "duiè tractatâ" kept as printed; "sororē" read from a worn abbreviation mark; "cōspectu" with the ligature read as ct; "Æmy. li. 1." last numeral uncertain. Numbers "4448", "486", "4478", "516" and "45" copied as printed, with spacing in the print reduced.
